verdict.rationale: Mollie Checkout's hosted pages let customers pick their payment method from a single integration (mollie-docs-21). Apple Pay is documented, though only as a button in the Magento 2 plugin (mollie-docs-35). The pack never names Google Pay, bank-redirect methods or BNPL, so the multi-method breadth is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Google Pay, bank redirects (e.g. iDEAL) and BNPL support; Apple Pay documented for the core API rather than only the Magento plugin; a published list of supported methods; independent or hands-on corroboration.
